About this item

  • 【A NEW EDGE FOR YOUR FAVORITE BANDIT】 The Raccoon returns with a bold new attitude. This time, it's armed with a 3.25" 14C28N Modified Sheepsfoot blade—clean, controlled, and built for precision. With its straight edge and subtly reinforced tip, this blade excels at push cuts, slicing, and detailed work. It delivers excellent control for opening packages, trimming cord, breaking down boxes, or handling everyday tasks that demand accuracy over flash. A straight fuller runs along the blade, offering a sleek yet sophisticated appearance.
  • 【CONTROLLED PERFORMANCE】 Equipped with the Top Liner Lock and button-operated action, the Raccoon deploys with satisfying smoothness and locks up solidly. It's easy, secure, and built to handle daily carry without hesitation.
  • 【BUILT TO CARRY】 The 4.36" ergonomic handle is carefully chamfered for comfort during extended use. Choose between rugged G10 for a durable, grippy feel or classic Micarta for a warmer, more tactile touch. Its blade-to-handle balance is meticulously designed to reduce hand fatigue, allowing for comfortable extended use.
  • 【EVERYDAY RESOURCEFUL】 Raccoons are known for adaptability and clever problem-solving. This Modified Sheepsfoot version follows the same philosophy—efficient, reliable, and ready to work. From daily carry to weekend tasks, this Raccoon isn't just sharp. It's smart.
  • 【Vosteed Trust】 Get your 100% satisfaction of the product is our eternal pursuit. Due to our pursuit of high quality and excellent service, we have been recognized by more and more knife enthusiasts.
